FIXTURE DE STRUCTURE — SYNTHÉTIQUE À 100 % (aucun contenu réel de module)
=========================================================================
Forme relevée par la lane ingestion-dks-analyse (passe analyse v0, 2026-08-25)
sur la classe « gamebook DM-less à entrées nommées + booklet de cartes » :
entrées en CAPS reliées par des renvois « go to entry X », statblock inline
non canonique, pointeurs de tilepage, section maps en images.

Cette fixture sert de cible de structure pour une future route déterministe
S2 « entrées nommées ». Les noms, nombres et textes sont INVENTÉS.

--- 8< --- début du module factice -----------------------------------------

THE SILVER BADGER'S LANTERN: A SOLO TEST MODULE (FIXTURE)

INTRODUCTION
This fixture mimics the shape of a named-entry solo gamebook. Read one
entry, pick an option, go to the named entry. Nothing here is real.

MOVING BETWEEN MAPS
At the edge of each tilepage are numbers and arrows. Move your token to
the adjoining tilepage indicated by the arrow you crossed.

D100 CHANCE ROLLS
Occasionally you will be told to make a d100 roll. Roll twice on the
table below and combine both results if the moon is waxing.

D100 TABLE (FIXTURE)
01-40: Nothing happens tonight.
41-80: A stray lantern drifts past the hedge row.
81-00: The badger demands a toll of two copper sparks.

BACKSTORY (FIXTURE)
The Warden of Amber Hollow vanished three nights ago. You promised the
lampwright you would look for the silver badger's lantern before dawn.

ADVENTUREBEGINS
You wake at the edge of Amber Hollow with damp boots and a dull ache.
* Follow the lamplight north? Go to entry NORTHGATE
* Search the reeds first? Go to entry REEDBANK

REEDBANK
The reeds whisper though there is no wind. A tin badge glints in the
mud.
* Take the badge? Add a Tin Badge to your inventory. Go to entry NORTHGATE
* Leave it. Go to entry NORTHGATE

NORTHGATE
A crooked gate leans over the path. Make a perception check, DC 11.
Make a dexterity save, DC 12 if you decide to climb it instead.

BADGERBATTLE
Place three tokens on the map within melee range of your token.
Roll initiative!

Badger Sentinel (FIXTURE STATS - SHAPE ONLY)
Small Beast, Neutral
Armour Class 11
Hit Points 7
Speed 20 ft., Burrow 5 ft.

STR 8 (-1)
DEX 12 (+1)
CON 10 (0)
INT 2 (-4)
WIS 12 (+1)
CHA 6 (-2)

ATTACKS
Snap: +3 melee, Hit 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage.

* If you win, go to entry LANTERNFOUND
* If you lose, make a d100 roll, then go to entry RETREATPATH

LANTERNFOUND
The lantern hums like a sleepy wasp. Your quest ends here, for now.

TILEPAGE 1
Find tilepage 1 in the Maps Booklet.
Place your token on the square nearest the gate.
OPTIONS:
* Checking for traps?: Go to entry TRAPCHECK
* When ready, move toward the green marker to go to entry NORTHGATE

MAPS BOOKLET (pages image uniquement - jamais lues comme texte)
1 MAPS BOOKLET (cover)
2 TILEPAGE 1
3 SUB-MAP 1

--- >8 --- fin du module factice --------------------------------------------
